Third **beta** of Faraón (Farár / Prší), a test build. New: the game now comes as an **Android app** too.

## What's new

- **Android APK.** Install it on your phone directly from this page:
  1. Open this release page on the phone and download **Faraon-0.1.2-beta-Android.apk**.
  2. Open the downloaded file. Android asks you to allow your browser (or file manager) to **install unknown apps**: allow it once, go back, and tap **Install**.
  3. Requirements: **Android 7.0 or newer** on a **64-bit (arm64) phone**, which covers practically every phone from the last several years. Older 32-bit-only phones and x86 tablets aren't supported by this build.
  4. Later betas install **over** this one, and your progress stays.
- **Back button and back gesture on Android.** Back no longer closes the game mid-round:
  - at the table it opens the pause menu (back again closes it); on the results screen it returns to the main menu;
  - in Settings, Appearance, Challenges, Statistics or Multiplayer it returns to the main menu, and an open dialog closes first;
  - in the tutorial it works like **Skip** (you can replay the tutorial from the menu any time);
  - only on the main menu does it close the app.
- **Esc** on the PC does the same (except it never closes the game on the main menu).
- **Music pauses** when you switch away from the app on the phone and continues when you return.
- Vibration permission added to the Android app, so the **Vibrations** setting works.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Faraon-0.1.2-beta-Android.apk** | Android app (Android 7.0+, arm64). See the install steps above. |
| **Faraon-0.1.2-beta-PC.exe** | Windows desktop version. A 16:9 window sized to your screen. You can resize it freely; **F11** or **Alt+Enter** switches to fullscreen. |
| **Faraon-0.1.2-beta-Phone.exe** | Windows phone-layout version for testing the mobile layout on a PC. A fixed **portrait** window shaped like a phone (19.5:9); the mouse works like a finger. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums of the downloads. |

The .exe files are single files: no install. Your progress from earlier betas carries over (same save folder, `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Faraón`).

> **Windows SmartScreen:** the beta isn't code-signed. If you see "Windows protected your PC",
> click **More info → Run anyway**.

> **Android / Play Protect:** the APK is a debug-signed beta, not from Google Play. Play Protect may
> warn about an unknown app or offer to scan it; choose **Install anyway** (or "More details" →
> install). The app asks for no special permissions (only internet for multiplayer and vibration).

## Known limitations

- Multiplayer needs the game server, which isn't deployed yet.
- Ads and purchases are simulated: no real payment.
- The Android build is a debug-signed beta for testing outside Google Play. The Play Store version will be signed differently, so moving to it later will need one uninstall of the beta.

**SK:** Nová **Android aplikácia**: APK si stiahni priamo v telefóne z tejto stránky, povoľ prehliadaču „inštaláciu neznámych aplikácií" a nainštaluj (Android 7.0 a novší, 64-bitový telefón). Ďalšie bety sa nainštalujú cez túto a postup ostane. Tlačidlo/gesto **späť** už neukončí hru uprostred kola: pri stole otvorí pauzové menu, v podobrazovkách sa vráti do menu, v tutoriáli funguje ako Preskočiť a appku zavrie len na hlavnom menu. Hudba sa pri odchode z appky pozastaví.
